notes.title: Participating in Tokyo Game Show (TGS2025)
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45318046/fe721eb201a55477f0b572e828b8ff517767f32d.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][b]Doomed Otaku[/b] is heading to Tokyo Game Show 2025![/h2][p]Thanks to the Gyeonggi Content Agency's overseas market expansion support program, we've been given the amazing opportunity to participate in this year's Tokyo Game Show.[/p][p]You can try out [b]Doomed Otaku[/b] at the Korea Pavilion booth, located at [b]02-C05[/b].[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Dates[/b] ┃ September 25-28[/h3][h3][b]Venue[/b] ┃ Makuhari Messe Hall 2, 1st floor[/h3][h3][b]Booth[/b] ┃ 02-C05[/h3][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45318046/196ea71c7dc5d53fe805efcfc6add2b22e64b629.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45318046/049231c0ac1a7057b8223824e9b59b5daeec00c8.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45318046/be0957268c8db2a596113f552ece209bd36f514f.png"][/img][/p][p]We look forward to seeing you at Tokyo Game Show![/p][p]Additionally, we would like to conclude by introducing a new title and video for [b]Doomed Otaku.[/b][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="4bvi8edxMac;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3360610/_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Participation in the Busan Indie Connect Festival (BIC)
notes.content: [h2]Doomed Otaku is participating in BIC 2025![/h2][p]The Busan Indie Connect Festival (BIC) is an international indie game event held every year in Busan. Doomed Otaku has qualified to participate and will be showcasing our game there.[/p][p][/p][h3]Dates ｜ August 15 - 17[/h3][h3]Venue ｜ Busan BEXCO Exhibition Center 1, Hall 1[/h3][h3]Booth ｜ C053[/h3][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45318046/9d77e887ac7c521ad442cad6758dda9bf556f7f3.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45318046/3d494b08838840642d57bae0447dc1c7933b7fd2.png"][/img][/carousel][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3360610/__Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: August Doomed letter
notes.content: [p]Hello, this is Kiwisaurus, the development team behind [b]Doomed Otaku[/b].[/p][p]Let's dive into the Doomed letter.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]First News: BitSummit Kyoto Recap[/h2][p][b]Doomed Otaku[/b] exhibited at BitSummit, held in Kyoto from July 18th to 20th.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45318046/9b789ba6835bfcb9cd0cbd3b40608fa303291599.jpg"][/img][/p][p]As this was [b]Doomed Otaku's[/b] first overseas event, we had many concerns. But, to our pleasant surprise, an incredible number of people visited the [b]Doomed Otaku[/b] booth! To borrow the words of Yongdeok, our planner who managed the booth... "To exaggerate a little, the line went all the way to the wall..." 🤣 [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45318046/5fcfcb199f90d30e1157947cef15af44daf30fc2.jpg"][/img]The shining purple neon sign and the large screen displaying gameplay footage seemed to attract a lot of attention, which really helped draw in visitors. We observed several times that people passing by showed interest in the gameplay screen and took photos.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Second News: ChinaJoy Shanghai Participation Announced[/h2][p]We're excited to announce our participation in ChinaJoy, taking place from August 1st to 3rd! [b]Doomed Otaku[/b] will be in the B2B (Business Hall), so we haven't promoted it much to general players since we won't be meeting them directly. However, we're providing this information for anyone who might be planning to attend.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Booth Location:[/b] W3-B910[/h3][h3][b]Dates:[/b] August 1st (Fri) ~ 3rd (Sun)[/h3][h3][b]Venue:[/b] Shanghai New International Expo Centre, China[/h3][p][/p][p][url="https://weibo.com/8007102179/PCIaQiil5" style="button"]Doomed Otaku Official Weibo Account[/url][/p][p]On our Weibo account, we're holding an event to give away B2B hall admission tickets for August 3rd. If you're interested, please click the link above to check it out.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45318046/ab38393a95457a59f15da0e29a4045bd35390bb5.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45318046/1736b905588bce7f986b693e5ce2f15053757d1c.png"][/img][/p][p](Kiwisaurus made limited edition stickers again this time!)[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Third News: Kiwisaurus Official Website Launched[/h2][p][/p][p][url="http://kiwi-saurus.com/" style="button"]Kiwisaurus Official Website[/url][/p][p]It's still a work in progress, but we've officially launched a website where you can find all our links, including those for [b]Doomed Otaku[/b], at a glance.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Concluding Remarks[/h2][p]That's all the news we have to share for now. In our next post, we'll bring you updates on our upcoming participations in August's BIC, September's Tokyo Game Show, and October's Osaka Indie Game Summit. Thank you![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3360610/__Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

[/list]
